# space-types-policy — the machine-readable form of the space-types D0 verdict.
#
# ⚠️ VENDORED COPY. The source of truth is an upstream copy maintained
# alongside the gate's test suite. Edit it there and re-copy.
#
# ⛔ DO NOT EDIT verdict: TO MAKE A RED GATE GREEN. A verdict other than
# UNANSWERED requires a decided-by: line citing a lookup-able decision record —
# a Linear comment URL carrying #comment-<id>, or coordinator-decision:<n>.
# The gate REFUSES a verdict without one, and REFUSES free text (tests T9,
# T22b, T22c).
#
# ── THE VERDICT: V-SPLIT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Each entry in reference-data/space-types.json is split into two halves:
#
#   open-fields        id, label, aliases, category, locales. The published
#                      vocabulary: every entry carries all five.
#   commercial-fields  tier, urgencyFlag, promptText. The elicitation
#                      experience (the ordering, the prompts and the nudges
#                      that help someone finish listing their possessions).
#                      These are not part of the open vocabulary, and no
#                      entry may carry them.
#
# V-SPLIT supersedes an earlier V-OPEN verdict, under which all eight keys were
# published as open vocabulary. The earlier verdict is recorded here rather than
# erased so that the history shows a reversal, not a verdict that never existed.
# The three commercial fields are maintained outside this repository.
#
# ── COVERAGE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Every spaceType enum value in v3/space.json has an entry, and every entry's id
# is an enum value (or a schema-permitted extension). Measured at 101 enum
# values and 101 entries. reference-data/space-types.json:6 -- "Every enum value
# in space.json has a corresponding entry here" -- is TRUE as published.
#
# NO `exclusions:` LINE IS SET, and that is correct rather than an omission:
# coverage is complete, so there is nothing to exclude.
#
# ⛔ Do not add an `exclusions:` line to silence a future red: a new enum value
# with no entry is the gate working, and the remedy is the row, not the
# carve-out.
#
# The UNANSWERED freeze pins (frozen-entry-count / frozen-fields / frozen-ids)
# are deliberately absent: they apply only while the verdict is UNANSWERED, and
# a pin forbidding additive rows would contradict the coverage rule above.
verdict: V-SPLIT
decided-by: coordinator-decision:588
open-fields: id,label,aliases,category,locales
commercial-fields: tier,urgencyFlag,promptText
